meta.title: Motor Neuron Diseases | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Enhancing comfort, function and quality of life through supportive care.

overview: Motor neuron diseases such as ALS progressively affect the nerves that control movement, breathing and swallowing. While curative treatment is not yet available, specialist rehabilitation and long-term care can significantly improve quality of life and reduce the burden on families.

At Cambridge Hospital, we offer coordinated motor neuron disease therapy and rehabilitation covering respiratory support, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech and swallowing care, nutritional management and psychological support for both patients and caregivers.
